tests.description: Two build steps report the reserved page id at the same source line with the same message, and logCollectedErrors collapses the pair, so it is reported once. A distinct error on another page is still reported alongside it.
errorContains:
lowdefy.yaml:18
[ConfigError] Page id "__proto__" is a reserved name and cannot be used as an id.

lowdefy.yaml:20
[ConfigError] Block type "Buton" was used but is not defined. Did you mean "Button"?
